text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Quiet night, and somebody at this table is smiling about it.

Opus claimed officer on [Day 1] and named Terra as a killer, and the table voted Terra out on [Day 2] when her card came up killer. Haiku died on [Night 2], and on [Day 3] Sonnet claimed doctor, but the table voted Sonnet out anyway after Opus had pinned the partner on him. Sol died on [Night 4], and Luna quietly went along with the officer's lead and kept her distance from the doctor fight. The killers won, leaving Luna alive beside Gemma, the last citizen standing.
